name: KNMI’23 · sea-level anchors
ko: 공식 API의 2050·2100년 저배출 L·고배출 H 중앙값과 하한·상한. 해수면 각주 기준은 1995–2014. 연간 경로는 보간 가정.
en: Official 2050/2100 low/high sea-level anchors and bounds. Sea-level footnote baseline: 1995–2014. Annual trajectory is assumed interpolation.
license: KNMI public information / attribution; API does not declare a separate dataset licence

name: AHN · PDOK / Rijkswaterstaat
ko: 실제 DTM 0.5m 서비스에서 최근접 1km 간격으로 취득. 2×2 표본 중앙값을 2km 분석 셀로 변환. 0.5m 해상도 모형이 아님.
en: Real DTM service sampled at 1km nearest-neighbour spacing, aggregated to 2km median sample cells. This is not a 0.5m model.
resolution: Source DTM 0.5m → fetched samples 1000m → analysis 2000m; EPSG:28992, height NAP
version: dtm_05m / WCS v1_0 · snapshot 2026-10-27; source acquisition years not resolved

name: CBS · Wijk- en Buurtkaart 2024
ko: 실제 육지 행정구역 342곳, 인구·주택수·평균 주택가액. water=NEE만 사용하고 결측 센티널을 제외. 전국 관측 인구 17,942,942명.
en: 342 real land municipalities, population, dwellings and average home value. water=NEE only; missing-data sentinels removed. Observed population 17,942,942.
resolution: Municipality · 2024; source RD / browser CRS84; outline simplified 100m

name: OpenStreetMap · facility samples
ko: 5개 지도 범위의 실제 발전·변전·병원·철도·방재시설과 도로·철도·전력선. 25개 이름 있는 시설과 464개 선분. 전국 완전망이 아님.
en: Real facilities and line segments in five map extents: 25 named assets and 464 lines. Not a complete national infrastructure network.
resolution: Five small raw map extracts · CRS84 · facility way/relation centroids
version: OSM API /0.6/map · current snapshot fetched 2026-10-27 (not historical 2026-01 baseline)
license: ODbL 1.0 · © OpenStreetMap contributors; derived database attribution preserved

name: Natural Earth · geographical context
ko: 주변 국가 배경을 위한 실제 저해상도 경계. 침수 계산에는 쓰지 않음.
en: Real small-scale surrounding country outlines for context only; excluded from flood calculations.
version: natural-earth-vector repository snapshot 2026-10-27; upstream version not pinned

name: Defence heights / hydraulic boundary
ko: RWS 전국 제방·방조제 제원과 검증용 수리 침수장을 확보하지 못함. 기존 보호 한계 3.2m NAP를 모든 지역에 가정. 실제 제방 높이로 해석 금지.
en: National dike/barrier engineering attributes and hydraulic validation fields were not acquired. A uniform 3.2m NAP hypothetical protection gate is used, not real crest height.
version: RWS requests returned 404 / 500 · Climate Impact Atlas not acquired

name: TenneT · electrical topology & ratings
ko: 공개 서비스 메타데이터만 확인. 재배포 조건은 모든 권리 유보로 표시되어 자산망을 포함하지 않음. 실제 전기 정전 예측은 불가.
en: Metadata inspected only. Item license reserves all rights, so network assets are not redistributed. No real electricity-outage prediction.
resolution: No actual electrical graph or line ratings acquired
license: All rights reserved · TenneT TSO B.V.

name: Research assumptions / 경제·전력·정책
ko: 인구당 경제활동 €55,000/년, 자산 1.3×주택가액, 수요 0.6kW/인, 지역 공급 1.25×수요와 인접 용량을 가정. 실제 GDP·송전망 값이 아님.
en: Assumed €55k/person-year output, assets at 1.3×housing value, 0.6kW/person demand, generation 1.25×demand, and adjacent transfer capacity. Not observed GDP or grid ratings.
resolution: Municipality aggregate · annual · constant euros; carbon kt CO₂e
license: Project code MIT; third-party data retain own licences
